alternatives_and_negative_results: Do not infer range resolution from single-target localization, or a joint population acceptance rule from a reported J metric.
applicability: Radar target-list performance scoring and future multi-target range/Doppler acceptance.
assessed_root_cause: Association is a scoring relation; range and Doppler accuracy are separate estimator properties and have separate eligibility conditions.
author_role: historical project engineering record, backfilled by FPGA engineering copilot
chosen_corrective_method: Keep D/R/V/E/J and the binding requirement fields separate; predefine matching gates and report attempted, eligible and ineligible trials.
generalizable_lesson: Define detection association, parameter accuracy, eligibility and composite success as distinct metrics with explicit denominators and binding status.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: One detection could be matched to multiple truth targets, or a target-association PASS could be interpreted as a universal range/velocity accuracy or composite Pd PASS.
non_applicability: Does not establish two-target resolution near 600 m or performance across clutter/off-bin/other SNR conditions.
observable_consequence: S02 defines one-to-one truth association separately from estimator-error checks; the fixed Pd main test was accepted only for one isolated single-target no-clutter scene, while J remained report-only without a new binding 90% rule.
observed_problem: Detection association, range/velocity estimation error, and joint detection-quality claims can produce different denominators and outcomes.
repeatable_validation: Check S02 matrix, frozen Pd protocol and 1000-CPI result; verify D=1000/1000 and the stated fixed-scene limitation.
reviewer_role: documentary evidence validation by FPGA engineering copilot; not a separate human reviewer
safety_contract_constraints: No unapproved Pd composite or new binding threshold; preserve S02 v1.2 and the exact accepted Pd scope.
title: Separate truth association, estimator accuracy and binding acceptance criteria
